query:
select count(*) as n from (select s.*, (select count(*) from contracts c where c.subscriber_id = s.id and c.status = $4) as active_contracts
         from subscribers s
         where ($1::text is null or s.name ilike $5||$1||$6 or s.email ilike $7||$1||$8 or ($2 <> $9 and (s.document like $10||$2||$11 or s.phone like $12||$2||$13)))
           and ($3::text is null or s.status = $3)
         order by s.name, s.id) x

select x.* from (select s.*, (select count(*) from contracts c where c.subscriber_id = s.id and c.status = $4) as active_contracts
         from subscribers s
         where ($1::text is null or s.name ilike $5||$1||$6 or s.email ilike $7||$1||$8 or ($2 <> $9 and (s.document like $10||$2||$11 or s.phone like $12||$2||$13)))
           and ($3::text is null or s.status = $3)
         order by s.name, s.id) x limit $14 offset $15

select c.*, s.name as subscriber_name, s.document as subscriber_document,
         p.id as plan_id, p.name as plan_name, pv.version as plan_version, pv.price_cents, pv.down_kbps, pv.up_kbps, pv.profile_name,
         coalesce((select json_agg(json_build_object($2, t.id, $3, t.name) order by t.name) from contract_tags ct join tags t on t.id = ct.tag_id where ct.contract_id = c.id), $4) as tags
  from contracts c
  join subscribers s on s.id = c.subscriber_id
  join plan_versions pv on pv.id = c.plan_version_id
  join plans p on p.id = pv.plan_id where c.id = $1

select c.*, s.name as subscriber_name, s.document as subscriber_document,
         p.id as plan_id, p.name as plan_name, pv.version as plan_version, pv.price_cents, pv.down_kbps, pv.up_kbps, pv.profile_name,
         coalesce((select json_agg(json_build_object($2, t.id, $3, t.name) order by t.name) from contract_tags ct join tags t on t.id = ct.tag_id where ct.contract_id = c.id), $4) as tags
  from contracts c
  join subscribers s on s.id = c.subscriber_id
  join plan_versions pv on pv.id = c.plan_version_id
  join plans p on p.id = pv.plan_id where c.subscriber_id = $1 order by c.created_at desc

select h.at, h.event, h.detail, u.name as actor_name from contract_history h left join users u on u.id = h.actor_id
         where h.contract_id = $1 order by h.id desc
select modules from tenants where id = $1
select pop_id from user_pops where user_id = $1
